rules: When requirements work needs a new or refreshed runnable prototype baseline before user-facing validation.
When the requirements basis and prototype goals are ready for focused interactive product exploration with the user.
When the deterministic prototype baseline and bootstrap evidence are ready for UX iteration.
When the baseline cannot be created or a source-technology constraint changes the requirements decision.
When the interactive prototype, approved UI/UX specification, visual references, and unresolved product questions are ready for requirements finalization.
